mapper.sql: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, u.email, u.phone, u.signature, u.role, u.status, u.create_time AS createTime, u.update_time AS updateTime, IFNULL(c.score, 100) AS creditScore, IFNULL(c.violation_count, 0) AS violationCount, c.last_violation_time AS lastViolationTime, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM video v WHERE v.user_id = u.id AND v.status != -1) AS videoCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_follow f WHERE f.follow_user_id = u.id) AS fansCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_follow f WHERE f.user_id = u.id) AS followingCount, IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_penalty p WHERE p.user_id = u.id AND p.status = 1 AND p.action = 'mute'), 0) AS muted, IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_penalty p WHERE p.user_id = u.id AND p.status = 1 AND p.action = 'ban'), 0) AS banned FROM user u LEFT JOIN user_credit c ON c.user_id = u.id

where.if: (u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.id = #{keywordId})
